text_block_list.text: I'm training with Эль Кондор Паса, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Agh... My eyes are killin' me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I was watchin' wrestling all night! I was so
caught
up in it, I didn't realize how late
it was! Haha!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But you know what? The wrestlers'
combo
techniques were insane!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'm not asleep! My mind just
couldn't keep
up with my body!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She won't admit it, but she's clearly
exhausted
from watching those
late-night matches.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
